sources: USGS NAIP with the catalog site points

values.note: 61 sites per the Forest Service, including double sites and a group site; recreation.gov's catalog has 60 (one a host site, 54). Catalog lengths 20-45 ft: 36 sites (one the host site) list RVs, mostly 30-45 ft; 21 sites are listed for tents and trailers only (most 20-25 ft) and 3 are tent-only. A few level pull-through and back-in sites suit larger RVs (pull-throughs include 03, 28, 30).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/williams-creek-campground ('Some of the 61 sites'; 'some double sites'; 'a few level pull-through and back-in sites appropriate for larger RVs'; 'Max RV size = 45 ft') + recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:251844 (60 sites; Max Vehicle Length 20-45; permitted equipment RV at 36 sites incl. host, Tent/Trailer only at 21, Tent at 3; Pull-Through at 03, 28, 30), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:251844 (8 sites with 'Water Hookup: Y' and 'Sewer Hookup: Y': 03, 04, 07, 08, 09 reservable, 01, 02, 06 first-come, none named host; every site typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/williams-creek-campground ('some with water and sewer hookups'; 'Single Site (water and sewer hookup): $35 per night'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No dump station: the nearest is in Pagosa Springs. Firewood sold by the camp host.

values.note: 32 sites reservable on recreation.gov (the catalog marks 36) up to 4 days ahead; the rest first come, first served, claimed in person. Often full on summer weekends. 2026 reservation season May 8 - Sept 26; the 2027 table runs May 2 - Sept 27. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

note: USFS campground among ponderosa, aspen and juniper on Williams Creek, about 23 mi N of Pagosa Springs via Piedra Rd (CR 600 / FR 631) and FR 640, ~1 mi below Williams Creek Reservoir. Some sites on the east loop sit on the creek bank; many have mountain views. Dispersed camping is closed along upper FR 640. Washboard forest-road access. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov (251844) API/rates/catalog: confirmed 61 sites, max 45 (FS), water+sewer at 8 sites (5 reservable, 3 first-come), no electric, vault toilets, potable water, no dump, $30 base (2026-2028), reservable with FCFS sites; added pull-throughs, season May-Sept, booking (4-day cutoff, 14 nights, reservation season 05-08 to 09-26). Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Phone 970-264-2268 confirmed: Pagosa Ranger District (FS Williams Creek page, Office Contact Information; recreation.gov facility phone the same). recreation.gov's '(661) 702-1420' is the concessionaire's (Explorus).

Water/sewer: 8 public sites have both (03, 04, 07, 08, 09 reservable; 01, 02, 06 first-come); none named host. Over the 3-public-yes bar, so water/sewer true stands. Electric 0: every site is typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC.
Fit: 21 catalog sites are 'Tent'/'Trailer' only with no RV listed, mostly 20-25 ft, and 3 are tent-only; 35 public sites list RVs, mostly 30-45 ft. EKKO should book an RV-listed site.

Road/flood (Oct 22-25, 2026): San Juan NF conditions page, Pagosa Ranger District table 'As of October 27, 2026': 'Piedra Road CR 600 / 631 Caution ... 10/23/26 - Road crossing at Roush Draw is compromised, water flowing above culvert on road and cutting into road bed ... Remains open all year, plowed in winter'; 'Williams Creek (1st gate to 2nd gate at the lake) 640 Open'. Piedra Road is the only access, so it is passable with caution as of Oct 27. Neither the FS nor recreation.gov page has any surface or RV wording for the road. The campground is not named in any closure; its reservation season ended Sept 26.
Pin 37.49520,-107.22670 (= FS facility point) sits at the campground road junction by sites 17-19, 159 m from the centroid of the 60 catalog points and 63 m from the nearest site. OK.

Waterfront (stored creekside, kept): recreation.gov/FS 'Some sites are located on the banks of Williams Creek, which runs along the eastern edge of the campground'. On NAIP the creek is ~5-8 m wide (creek size) and meanders along the east side of the SE loop (sites 6-12): a spur off that loop near sites 10-11 ends within ~5 m of the bank, and site 11's catalog point is ~25 m from it across open grass. The north loops (A-D, sites 20-61) are 70 m+ from the creek. Creekside is earned at the east loop.
